REPORT OF THE COMMISSION
BY THE COMMISSION:
This report is the culminating effort in our examination of existing rules and regulations that determine the size of commercial zones of municipalities and terminal areas of motor carriers and freight forwarders. Recognizing that changes have occurred in the location of business and industrial activity since the development of existing commercial zone regulations in the mid-1940's, this Commission, on its own motion, instituted a rulemaking proceeding to scrutinize the present population-mileage formula in light of contemporary demographic and industrial location patterns. Notice of this rulemaking was published in the August 12, 1975, issue of the Federal Register.
